concerns.text: SC-006 (Statistical Power) is defined in tasks.md (T025b) but is missing from the spec.md Success Criteria section. The spec lists SC-001 through SC-005, leaving T025b without a corresponding FR/SC anchor in the specification.

FR-012 mandates an ablation study, but the spec's Success Criteria section (SC-001 to SC-005) does not explicitly define a measurable outcome for the ablation study results (e.g., 'incremental value of topology'). T023/T023b implement this, but the spec lacks a corresponding SC to measure the success of FR-012.

Task T025 is tagged for FR-007 but the description explicitly compares GNN against 'RF-Ablation' (graph features only). FR-007 text says 'Random Forest baseline (trained on graph-derived features only)', which matches the task, but the spec's FR-005 defines the primary baseline as 'standard molecular descriptors'. The task correctly implements the specific FR-007 text, but the ambiguity in the spec between FR-005 and FR-007 baselines creates a coverage gap where the 'primary baseline' (FR-005) has no specific statistical comparison task defined in the tasks list (T024 evaluates it, but T025 compares against the ablation).
